translation.name: Kitap molinas men ringkat na alaata'ala: perjanjian baru

book.name: Lukas
book.title: Lele Pore Men Ia Tadulkon I LUKAS

content: Taa' pongolukoni
Teofilus men angga'ion! Biai'mo a mian nampari-pari nunsusun ka' nuntulis lelena upa giigii' men nosida na ko'onta,
koi men ia tundunkon mian men daa nimiile' tumbe-tumbenapo upa men nosida, ka' komburi'na nengelelekon lele iya'a.
Noko daa yaku' sarak pore-pore a upa men tuutuu'na nosida na tumbenapo, yaku' munsurikon pore kalu muntulis ka' mangawawau kitap men susunon pore-pore boni Tuan,
kada' inti'ion ni Tuan se' upa men nipisiso'kon na ko'omuu, nono' tuutuu' kana'mo.
Malaa'ikat muntundunkon kongamea'an ni Yohanes Pansarani
Tempo batomundo'an ni Herodes na Yudea, isian imam men ngaanna i Zakharia. Ia tonsoop tompukanna imam Abia. Ngaanna boroki'na i Elisabet men lee' ni Imam Harun.
Rua-rua' irana tutuo'na sintutu' tia po'uusna Alaata'ala, malolo' na potoo-Na ka' titiu'po sianta idekna i raaya'a.
Kasee i raaya'a sian no'anakon, gause i Elisabet kamba' ka' uga' rua-rua' irana umurmo.
Na sa'angu' tempo, tompukanna imam Abia a men bo balimang na Laiganna Alaata'ala, ka' i Zakharia bo pingilimang palimangonna Tumpu.
Gause nokana' undi koi men doodoopo bo pinginti'ian too imam ime a men bo pingilimang, mbaka' ia uga' ninsoopmo na Laiganna Alaata'ala ka' nuntunu kamangian.
Pintanga' i Zakharia muntunu kamangian na lalomna Laiganna Alaata'ala, giigii' mian nobarimpungmo na liwana ka' nosambayang.
Na tempo iya'a, malaa'ikatna Tumpu nintipiile'mo ni Zakharia kere-kerer paraas uanan na mesba puntunuan kamangian.
Nimiile' men koiya'a, tongkodi' i Zakharia, mbaka' i ia nolayaonmo.

Malaa'ikat iya'a norobumo taena, “Zakharia, alia layaon! Pa'ase'em na sambayaang daa ia loloikonmo Tumpu. Boroki'im bo mangamea'kon sa'angu' anak moro'one bo ko'oom, ka' i ia tiodaa ngaanion i Yohanes.
Koo bo beles tuu', ka' uga' biai' a mian bo mongkobeleskon kongamea'anna.
Ia bo sida mian moola' koi pimiile'na Alaata'ala. Ia sian sida minginum anggur kabai se' minginum upa kolio', ka' uga' na kompongpo i ia bo bariosonna Alus Molinas.
Ia bo mimisiso' mian biai' na Israel kada' mule'kon malolo' na Alaata'ala, Tumpuna i raaya'a.

Ia taka mongolukoni Tumpu ka' noana tia kuasana koi noa tia kuasa ni Elia. Ia bo mompooka'amatikon tama tia anakna ka' mombolii gau'na mian men ba'idek kada' sida mian ma'amat. Ia bo mingilimang koiya'a kada' daa mian batoropot bona Tumpu.”
Zakharia norobumo na malaa'ikat iya'a taena, “Koi upa kada' yaku' sida mamarasaya men koiya'a? Yaku' langkai'mo ka' boroki'ku uga' boroki'mo.”
Ia simbati malaa'ikat iya'a taena, “Yaku' i Gabriel men balimang na Tumpu. Yaku' ia posuu' Tumpu morobu ka' mengelelekon lele pore kani'i na ko'oom.
Upa men yaku' porobukonmo bo sida kalu temponamo. Kasee ka' i koo sian mamarasaya, mbaka' i koo bo sida umu' pataka sida a men koi taengku'.”
Tempo iya'a, biai' a mian inde'e na liwana mempeperai i Zakharia. Raaya'a samba' gause i Zakharia nanau' tuu' na lalomna Laiganna Alaata'ala.

Tempo i Zakharia no'umuar, ia sianmo ninsida norobu na ko'ona i raaya'a, mbaka' ia inti'imo i raaya'a se' i Zakharia nimiile'mo simpalaalung na lalomna Laiganna Alaata'ala. Ia somo mosaasiso' gause no'umu'mo.
Noko daa i Zakharia ningilimang palimangonna na Laiganna Alaata'ala, ia nomule'konmo na laiganna.
Sian paraa nanau', Elisabet nampaiwawamo. Koi lima' bitu'on ia sian nintipiile' na mian biai'.
Taena i Elisabet, “Tumpu nuntulungmo i yaku', gause i Ia nanganuikonmo maa'ku na mian biai'.”
Malaa'ikat muntundunkon kongamea'an ni Yesus
Konoomna bitu'on a nampaiwawaan ni Elisabet, Alaata'ala nomosuu'mo malaa'ikat Gabriel mae' na Nazaret, sa'angu' kota na tano' Galilea,
mae' na sa'angu' laandue' men sianpo nontoo poobeel tia moro'one. Ngaanna laandue' iya'a i Maria. Ia ndoloi ni Yusuf men lee' ni Daud.
Malaa'ikat iya'a notakamo ni Maria ka' norobu taena, “Tabea' na ko'oom, wiwine men nibarakaati! Tumpu mandagai i koo.”
Nongorongor wurung koiya'a, tongkodi' i Maria. Ia nompoo'inurutikonmo se' upa a aratina tabea' iya'a.
Taena malaa'ikat, “Maria, alia layaon, gause i koo kolingu'na Alaata'ala.
Koo bo mampaiwawa ka' mangamea'kon sa'angu' anak moro'one men tiodaa ngaanioon i Yesus.
Ia bo balaki' a kuasa-Na ka' bo ngaanon Anakna Alaata'ala men na ko'alayo'an. Tumpu Alaata'ala bo mongorookon na Ko'ona Batomundo'an ni Daud men puli-Na.
Ia bo pontomundo'i lee' ni Yakub pataka sidutu ka' batomundo'an-Na sian kokabu-kabusanna.”
Taena i Maria na malaa'ikat iya'a, “Koi upa bo kosidana men koiya'a, gause i yaku' sianpo langakai'an?”

Ia simbati malaa'ikat iya'a taena, “Alus Molinas bo malau taka na ko'oom, ka' kuasana Alaata'ala men na ko'alayo'an bo mandagai i koo. Mbali' iya'a, Anak men bo ngamea'konoon tio ngaanon Molinas, Anakna Alaata'ala.
Imamat ini'imari! Ai Elisabet, poto'utusaan men ngaanonna mian se' kamba', mase nampaiwawamo ka' bo mangamea'kon sa'angu' anak moro'one. Koini'i kompongna noommo bitu'on.
Gause sianta upa men sian pokoonna Alaata'ala wawauon.”
Taena i Maria, “Yaku' kani'i mase tongko' ata'na Tumpu. Bi sida na wakangku koi wurungmuu kanooro'o.” Kasi malaa'ikat iya'a namarerei i Maria.
Maria nobaleleong nari Elisabet
Sian paraa nanau', ai Maria liuliu nomae'mo na sa'angu' kota men na buu'na Yehuda.
Taka na laigan nari Zakharia, ia ninsoopmo ka' nantabe'i i Elisabet.
Sarataa i Elisabet nomorongor tabea' ni Maria, anak men na kompongna nogumiokmo, ka' i Elisabet uga' ia bariosmo Alus Molinas.
Ia norobumo boolak taena, “Tumpu nambarakaati i koo labi wiwine sambana, ka' nambarakaati Anak na kompoong kanono'.
Ime i yaku' kani'i mbali' daa leleongionna sinana Tumpungku?
Sarataa yaku' nomorongor tabea'am, anak men na kompongku kani'i lako-lako nogumiok gause nobeles.
Barakaatan i koo, gause i koo parasaya se' upa men ia porobukon Tumpu na ko'oom bo sidakonon-Na.”
Sukuuran kobelesan ni Maria
Taena i Maria,

content.text: “Yaku' muntunde' Tumpu,
ka' noangku basukuur gause Alaata'ala, Pansalamatkon i yaku'.
Ia ningimamatmo i yaku', ata'-Na men talalais.
Supu koini'i-waara'ana giigii' mian bo mangaan se' i yaku' nibarakaati,
gause Alaata'ala men Pungkuasai nangawawaumo upa men angga'an tuu' bona ingku'.
Alaata'ala iya'a molinas.
Ka' lingu'-Na bo rookonon-Na sunsun ka' sunsun na mian men malolo' na Ko'ona.
Na wawau-Na men kosamba', Ia mimpipiile'kon kuasa-Na mantabunsalang giigii' mian men mintidaa-daa.
Ia mamalaukon tomundo' men pintanga' batomundo',
ka' manganakat mian men sian angga'ion.
Men kololuan taraion-Na giigii' men pore bi kalabian,
ka' Ia momosuu' mian kupangon mae' tia lima sompulo'.
Ia nuntulung Israel, ata'-Na,
gause koiya'a a toon-Na men Ia toonkonmo na pulinta.
Tumpu sian mongkolimbo'i toon-Na.
Ia molingu'kon i Abraham tia lee'na pataka sidutu.”

content: Maria nodumodongo ni Elisabet koi tolu' bitu'on a nau'na, kasi nomule'kon na dodongoanna.
Nongamea'an ni Yohanes Pansarani
Sarataa temponamo bitu'on ni Elisabet mindompu', mbaka' i ia nangamea'konmo sa'angu' anak moro'one.
Tempo pootolodoianna ka' poto'utusanna nongorongor se' Tumpu nongkolingu'kon i Elisabet, raaya'a uga' nobelesmo koi i Elisabet.
Sarataa walu'mo ilio a nongamea'anna anak iya'a, pootolodoianna ka' poto'utusanna notakammo munsunat anak iya'a. Raaya'a mingkira' mangaani anak iya'a i Zakharia koikoimo tia ngaanna tamana.
Kasee taena sinana anak iya'a, “Alia! Ia tiodaa ngaanion i Yohanes.”
Taena i raaya'a ni Elisabet, “Poto'utusanmuu sian isian ngaan men koi nooro'o.”
Kasi i raaya'a nosaasiso' mimikirawar ni Zakharia too ime a bo pangaanina anakna.
Zakharia nama'ase'mo watu bo puntulisan ka' nuntulis koi kani'imari: “Ngaanna i Yohanes.” Raaya'a giigii' nosamba'mo.
Na tempopo iya'a i ia lako-lako ninsida norobu soosoodo ka' nuntunde' Alaata'ala.
Mbaka' natakutmo a giigii' mian men pootolodoi tii raaya'a. Kasi upa men nosida iya'a notolele na longkop libutan na buu'na Yudea.
Giigii' i raaya'a men nomorongor lele iya'a ningintomkonmo ka' norobu taena, “Se' bo sida upa a anak kani'i na ilio komburi'?” Gause Tumpu mandagai i ia.
Sukuuran kobelesan ni Zakharia
Zakharia, tama ni Yohanes, ia bariosmo Alus Molinas. Ia nuntundunkon upa men bo sida na ilio komburi', taena,

content.text: “Tontunde' a Tumpu, Alaata'alana lipu' Israel,
gause i Ia muntulung mian-Na kada' salamat.
Ia mongorookon na ko'onta' Pansalamatkon men tingkai,
men ringkat na lee' ni Daud men ata'na Tumpu,
koi men mbaripian ia tundunkon nabii men molinas.
Kita bo tulungonna Pansalamatkon iya'a
kada' sianmo kuasaionna giigii' mian men maso'kon i kita.
Alaata'ala mimpipiile'kon lingu'-Na na pulinta,
ka' toon-Na men molinas iya'a loloikonon-Na.
Ya'amo a sumpa' men Ia toonkonmo ni Abraham pulinta
se' i Ia bo mongkolingu'kon i kita,
kada' kita tonsapu na mian men maso'kon i kita
ka' sianmo pata-patakut monsoosa' i Ia,
kasee i kita sidamo monsoosa' i Ia tia noa men maloos ka' molinas tempo i kita dauga' tumuo' na tano' balaki'.
Ka' i koo, anakku, bo ngaanonna mian nabiina Alaata'ala men na ko'alayo'an,
gause i koo bo sumalan mongolukoni Tumpu ka' mantatas salan bo Ko'ona.
Koo bo mimisiso'kon na mian-Na sasalanna Alaata'ala mansalamatkon i raaya'a tia mangampuni dosana i raaya'a.
Barakaat tia lingu'na Alaata'ala bo taka na ko'onta' mansalamatkon i kita.
Koi ruarna ilio ma'ulo-ulop men ringkat na ko'alayo'an,
koiya'a uga' i Ia bo mintingkari giigii' mian men tumuo' na kapintungan
ka' layaonkon lapus, kasi momosalan i kita na salan men ma'amat.”

content: Anak ni Zakharia iya'a no'uminsurmo ka' imaanna kaekae' moonggor. Ia dumodongo na tano' maleas pataka tempona i ia umuar mintipiile' na lipu' Israel.
